description: This is a PHP source file defining the BlogAdminController class within the Goteo content management system. It manages administrative actions related to blog posts, such as listing, editing, adding, and removing posts within the admin interface.

classes.name: BlogAdminController
classes.description: Controller class for managing blog posts in the admin panel, including listing posts and editing or adding new posts.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group category for this controller, which is 'communications'.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Defines and returns route configurations for the blog admin section.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles displaying the list of blog posts with optional search and pagination.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles creating new posts or editing existing posts, including form handling, deletion, and redirection.
